purpose.en: Gently work your hips into internal rotation.

text.zh: 膝盖和骨盆贴地，小腿向两侧打开
text.en: Keep your knees and pelvis down and let your shins open out to the sides

text.zh: 俯卧，双膝弯曲90度，小腿竖直
text.en: Lie face down with both knees bent to 90 degrees, shins upright.

text.zh: 停一下，再慢慢回到竖直
text.en: Pause, then bring your shins slowly back up.

commonErrors.en: Letting the pelvis lift or twist.

cautions.zh: 膝或髋疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your knees or hips hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
